title: Signal
description: A sunny park shot straight into the sun on a camcorder and played back off a worn VHS tape into an old TV, all of it modelled rather than drawn: the CCD blooms and smears, the luma rides an FM carrier that breaks into sparkles where it is driven too white, and the colour travels as a narrow band that smears and slips. Drag sideways to turn the tracking knob and the picture tears, rolls and runs into rainbows until you find the track again; drag down to wear the tape.
intent: herb's generative reference 3 (analog flare plant, /tmp/claude-0/gen-refs/3-analog-flare-plant.png): a real analog video picture with a blown flare, chroma bleed, head-switching wobble and dropouts. Rebuilt as a physical composite NTSC chain instead of a VHS filter: HDR scene with the sun's true energy, CCD bloom, smear and lag, YIQ encoder with a 3.58 MHz subcarrier, VHS FM luma with pre-emphasis and a real discriminator, colour-under chroma, tracking geometry across azimuth tracks, dropouts and DOC, flywheel sync and burst-locked colour in the TV, and a scanned monitor raster.
sources: Photograph: Sunny Vondelpark HDRI by Greg Zaal, Poly Haven, CC0 1.0, https://polyhaven.com/a/sunny_vondelpark (4:3 view reprojected from the equirectangular HDR, sun kept at its true radiance)
